constraints: Do not create approval until explicit owner decision on the exact content hash.
Owner approval is not independent human adjudication, ground truth or a freeze.

Never infer missing generation or review timestamps from receipt, filesystem times or approval time.
An approval timestamp, if actually documented, is a new decision event, not recovered review time.
Unknown duration remains null and excluded from timing/capacity denominators, not zero.
Do not exclude the untimed attempt from qualitative history or hide it from case counts.
No changes to experiment endpoints, thresholds, coverage gates, reserved set, model settings or TTL.
No contract review opened automatically upon factual approval.
future_implementation_requires: Versioned offline approval sidecar instrument and tests before any machine-readable approved outcome is consumed.
Separate owner approval of exact factual content; current request is not that approval.
Preserve failure of legacy aggregate validation when its timing requirements are unmet.
